entities.description: 5GSM message sent by the UE to complete the PDU session modification procedure.

entities.description: Procedure transaction identity used to associate the message with a specific procedure.

Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: Optional IE containing protocol configuration parameters.

entities.description: Optional IE containing port management information.

entities.description: Optional IE indicating the cause of a 5GSM procedure outcome.

relations.description: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message contains the Extended protocol discriminator IE.

PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message contains the PTI IE.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message contains the message type IE.
